day.headline: Sensex jumped 905 points (+1.24%) and Nifty 1.05% to 22,936.75 after the US Fed held rates overnight, led by FMCG, PSU bank and realty stocks, ending a two-day losing streak.
day.summary: Indian equities rallied on 29/10/2026 after the US Fed held its policy rate at 3.75%–4.00%, though two members voted for a hike and markets still price a December increase. Gains were broad: Bank Nifty rose 1.18%, and Nifty Midcap 100 and Smallcap 100 each gained about 1%. FIIs turned net sellers of ₹943.60 cr while DIIs bought ₹1,924.41 cr.

items.src: DD India; Oquilia (index closes); Tapetide and HDFC Sky (FII/DII)
items.title: Sensex +905 points to 74,151.04, Nifty +1.05% to 22,936.75 as FMCG, PSU banks and realty lead a broad rally
items.why: Most equity fund categories had a good day, because large, mid and small caps all rose about 1%. Nifty Realty gained 2.75%, Nifty FMCG 2.34% and Nifty PSU Bank 2.20%, while Nifty Auto slipped 0.24%. Analysts said the Nifty had moved back above its 20-day moving average (its average close over the last 20 sessions), with 23,000 as the next hurdle. DIIs, which include mutual funds, bought a net ₹1,924.41 cr and absorbed net FII selling of ₹943.60 cr (provisional).

items.title: US Fed holds rates at 3.75%–4.00% in a 10–2 vote, with two members voting for a hike; a December increase is priced in
items.why: The pause gave Indian markets some relief, but a likely US hike keeps the pressure on foreign flows and the rupee, which affects equity and international fund returns. The decision came at 14:00 ET on 28/10/2026, early on 29/10 in India. Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack dissented in favor of a 25 bp (0.25 percentage point) hike. Futures priced about an 85% chance of a hike at the 09/12/2026 meeting. GoodReturns cited a US 10-year Treasury yield of about 5.02% and noted that foreign outflows from India total about $31 billion so far in 2026. Separately, the Fed said it will hold fewer policy meetings from 2027.

items.title: Coal India Q2 FY27: profit up 57% to ₹6,547 cr, revenue up 21%; second interim dividend of ₹10.25
items.why: This is relevant to dividend-yield, PSU and energy funds that hold Coal India. Consolidated PAT (profit after tax) rose 57% to ₹6,547 cr from ₹4,167 cr, and revenue rose 21% to ₹44,179 cr. The record date for the dividend is 04/11/2026. Even so, the stock fell 2.31% to about ₹384 on NSE early on 30/10/2026, and HDFC Sky said the profit missed expectations. Sources disagree on the growth figure: Upstox reported 53%, to ₹6,516 cr, which may be a different basis of reporting.

items.title: HDFC MF redesignates Paul S Parampreet as Fund Manager – Equities, with immediate effect
items.why: Low impact for now: this is a title change in HDFC MF's SAI (Statement of Additional Information, the document listing key personnel), from Member of the Investment Team (Equity) to Fund Manager – Equities. No schemes were named, so no lead-manager change was reported. Watch for later addenda that assign him schemes.

items.title: ICICI MF files offer document with SEBI for an iSIF Sector Rotation Long-Short Fund
items.why: This is for HNI (high-net-worth) clients only. A SIF (Specialised Investment Fund) has a ₹10 lakh minimum application and can take limited short positions, here through unhedged derivatives. The proposed fund would rotate across a maximum of four sectors and be benchmarked to the NIFTY 500 TRI. It would charge a 1% exit load within 12 months and offer a growth option only. It is still only a filing, with no NFO dates announced.

items.title: Gold ETF FoF restrictions continue at about 17 fund houses; no date to reopen
items.why: Clients still can't make fresh lump sums, switch-ins, new SIP/STP registrations or (at most AMCs) SIP top-ups into gold ETF fund-of-funds. Existing SIP/STP instalments and redemptions mostly carry on. The curbs began 15–16/10/2026 at HDFC, ICICI Prudential, Kotak, Tata, DSP, Groww and others, "until further notice". No SEBI circular has been published, and the official reason is unconfirmed. On 02/11 Invesco said SIP top-ups on its Gold ETF FoF that were registered by 15/10/2026 will still be processed, but fresh subscriptions stay closed.

items.title: Axis Small Cap Fund adds Shreyash Devalkar as fund manager (effective 02/11/2026)
items.why: Low-to-moderate impact: one manager is added and nobody is removed. Tejas Sheth, Mayank Hyanki and Krishnaa N (foreign securities) all continue. The addendum doesn't say whether the lead manager changes, so watch the next factsheet.
